letter.company_line: Council inspection team that checks roads, footpaths, shared paths, drainage and bridges against the Road Management Plan
letter.subject: Application: Infrastructure Inspection Officer (11304), Marc Masarate
paragraphs: I am applying for the Infrastructure Inspection Officer role (reference 11304) advertised on the Moonee Valley careers site. The mix of field inspections, defect records and checking reinstatement works against drawings and permits is close to the site work I have done, and I would like to do it for a council close to home.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, and escalated issues that needed corrective action. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I helped with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, pavement and stormwater drainage to Australian Standards and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). I have not yet used a council asset management system or worked under a Road Management Plan, and I would expect to learn your inspection standards and systems first.
I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, which covers the 12 month term.
I've attached my resume and my response to the selection criteria is included with this application. I would be glad to talk about the role.
